# Jon Rover

> Jon Rover is the personal automotive website of Jon McGeehan, a Jaguar Land Rover sales consultant at Jaguar Land Rover Willow Grove in Willow Grove, Pennsylvania, serving buyers in the Philadelphia region.

Canonical website: https://www.jonrover.com/
Author and subject: Jon McGeehan (also known as Jon Rover)
Affiliation: Jaguar Land Rover Willow Grove
Primary topics: Land Rover, Range Rover, Range Rover Sport, Range Rover Velar, Range Rover Evoque, Defender, Discovery Sport, Jaguar, Certified Pre-Owned Land Rover vehicles, vehicle buying, vehicle comparisons, dealership fees, leasing, financing and vehicle selection.
